title: Dan Sherman taken to an NSA complex for sine-wave training
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Dan Sherman taken to an NSA complex for sine-wave training, about 1990s at Maryland (possibly Fort Meade), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he got taken to this NSA complex and he was given these headphones

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels relays the account of Dan Sherman, author of a book called Above Black, who says that in the 1990s he was taken to a complex run by the NSA, the US National Security Agency that handles electronic intelligence, possibly at Fort Meade in Maryland. There, according to Sherman, he was given headphones and trained using sine waves, simple pure tones. If true, it would mean a secret government program was training people for some kind of signal work tied to the unexplained.
